pages.text: “Deep purple hues conceal immense strength—silent yet holding explosive potential.”$(br2)Violet Tea is a richly flavored beverage made from dried violet flowers and sugar. The tea has a deep purple color with a distinctive floral aroma. Drinking it grants a temporary Strength boost, allowing travelers to unleash greater combat power.
$(br2)$(br)To prepare Violet Tea, $(br)boil dried violet flowers with sugar.$(br)It is best consumed before battle, empowering travelers with increased attack strength to swiftly defeat enemies.

Upon drinking Violet Tea, travelers gain a temporary Strength boost, increasing attack damage.$(br)This tea is perfect for combat enhancement, ideal for adventurers preparing for battle.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
